description: The sanity gate that chooses EGARCH or the EWMA fallback checks the filtered variance of ALL days including days after the test block, so a later volatility shock can switch the benchmark for earlier days. Already disclosed and quantified by the authors (docs/MODEL_ITERATIONS_REAL.md: 2 of 38 refits, 42 test days; a strictly real-time rule makes the benchmark 5.5% and 6.9% weaker). Reproduced here: in a 90-day simulated market with a 60-day fit, multiplying the volatility of days after day 75 by 2 flips the method for the whole sample from egarch_t to ewma (1.5 does not); on i.i.d. returns the flip needs a factor of 5.
reproduction: pytest tests/test_audit_agent1.py -k egarch_versus_ewma_choice (xfail strict); probe in the audit log
evidence: SYNTHETIC reproduction of a known and documented REAL-data effect.
recommended_action: Not changed: a real-time rule changes headline margins already printed in the documents. Keep the disclosure in the defence and quote the authors' own numbers (hybrid margins 5.9%, 7.9%, 6.5% without the 42 affected days).

description: The EWMA fallback floors the variance at 1% of the mean square of the WHOLE series, including days after the training window. The floor binds only if h falls below 1% of the overall mean square, which is rare, but the fallback was used in 2 of 38 Nifty refits (and in Bank Nifty and Fin Nifty refits).
evidence: Prefix of h changes when a huge future spike is appended (SYNTHETIC); unchanged for an ordinary rise.
recommended_action: Not changed (cannot rerun the committed pipeline without data/raw; any change must be followed by number tracing). Fix is one line: compute ms from y[:n_init].

description: Trading days after the last in-sample expiry get trading_days_to_expiry = NaN (the next expiry lies outside the sample) and build_dataset turns that NaN into 0, the value of an expiry day. The feature tdte (and the day_before_expiry flag) is therefore wrong for at most the last 4 trading days of any sample. is_expiry itself is correct.
evidence: label_days on Mon 18 Aug to Thu 11 Sep 2025 gives [2, 1, 0, NaN, NaN] for the last five days. SYNTHETIC.
recommended_action: Not changed: it would alter feature values of the last test days in committed results. Impact on committed numbers UNVERIFIED (needs data/raw). Suggest extending the rule-based calendar one week past the sample.

description: One missing 1-minute bar (a) makes its own return and the next return NaN, which build_market zero-fills, so the price move across the gap never enters realized variance; and (b) leaves NaN in close and volume, which are cumulated, so every anchor after the gap on that day has NaN ofi15, log_vol15_rel and abs_ret_today_sd. Other days are unaffected. min_coverage=0.95 allows up to 5% missing bars per day.
evidence: Synthetic unit test shows both effects. How many real days have gaps was not measured (data/raw absent): BLOCKED for the REAL part.
recommended_action: Count days with missing bars in the real files (scripts/validate_minute_bars.py already reports coverage) and state the number; consider forward-filling close for the cumulative features.

description: A price that needs sigma outside the bracket [1e-4, 5.0] returns the bracket edge, not NaN (sigma 6.0 -> 5.0, sigma 5e-5 -> 1e-4). Real Nifty vols are far inside the bracket, so no printed number is expected to change.
recommended_action: Not changed. If changed to NaN, build_gex_panel interpolation would fill the gap; rerun the panel number checks.

description: With parameters held fixed, arch's conditional variance for early days changes slightly when the series passed to it is longer (up to 0.8% in h between a 60-day and a 90-day series; forecasts for the first test block differed by at most 1.1e-4 relative when later days were altered). So the walk-forward is causal up to this numerical end effect, not bit-exact.

description: Missing implied variance for the first days is filled with ffill().bfill(), so early days borrow the first available later value. Harmless if the implied panel starts before min_train (true for the real files), a look-ahead if it starts later.
evidence: Inspection only; not executed on real data.
